case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the friendly, helpful staff, generous breakfasts, clean modern bathrooms and beautiful, spacious rooms, noting available parking, lounge and pool facilities and occasional upgrades. Some guests reported issues: noise from a nearby racetrack, occasional dog barking and minibar noise at night, a tricky bedroom TV, less-modern bedroom décor, and difficulty with stairs when carrying lots of luggage or being on upper floors.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Immediately verify published after‑hours contact reachability, monitor incidents, and reassess guest communications—don't assume staffing changes.

priorities.area: Wi‑Fi and in‑room technology (internet and TV)
priorities.recommendation: Assess short-term room Wi‑Fi/TV reliability; collect logs/vendor, determine scope/VPN impact, plan remediation or implement fixes.

priorities.area: Bathroom condition (functional drainage and decor consistency)
priorities.recommendation: Inspect shower drainage/plumbing immediately; assess bathroom decor consistency and avoid capital works without scope/cost assessment.
Provide pre-arrival noise info, earplugs, minibar mute/turn-off; log complaints; consider allocations; assess soundproofing, minibars.

priorities.area: In-room equipment & presentation (TV, minibar, decor consistency)
priorities.recommendation: Prepare visible TV/remote-instructions; train check-in-staff; confirm minibar-settings and offer nightly-disable; audit-plan upgrades; consider décor-refreshes.

priorities.area: Guest access / luggage handling for upper floors
priorities.recommendation: Proactively assist guests with luggage, note stair-only rooms online; train staff, evaluate feasibility.
